description: Check whether the local payment rail at the settlement destination is currently operational before executing. Use this when settling into a specific region or country — a DEGRADED or DOWN rail means the payment cannot complete even if DPX executes correctly. Returns per-rail status (OPERATIONAL/DEGRADED/DOWN), latency, and last incident for: PIX (Brazil), SEPA (Europe), FedACH (US domestic), CHAPS (UK), UPI (India), PromptPay (Thailand). Filter by rail name or region. A DEGRADED or DOWN result should trigger a hold — retry when the rail recovers.

rails.description: Specific rails to check: 'PIX', 'SEPA', 'FedACH', 'CHAPS', 'UPI', 'PromptPay'. Omit to get all rails.

region.description: Filter by region: 'latam', 'europe', 'us', 'asia', 'uk'. Alternative to specifying rails by name.

name: oracle.rails
